prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: revised high-fidelity desktop UI direction comp.
Primary request: Edit the supplied «Туту План Б» UI mockup, preserving its overall composition, center-weighted globe, header, right trip summary, three configuration controls, and bottom route-stage strip.
Change only these issues: replace the satellite-like realistic terrain globe with a clean modern illustrated globe using simplified but spatially credible continents, saturated blue ocean, flat layered land shapes, a very light atmosphere and no photorealistic relief; remove the large generic left navigation rail and give that space back to the centered planet, leaving only a compact vertical set of route/map controls; remove all copied or recognizable third-party carrier logos and replace them with neutral transport pictograms; remove the hotel photograph and use a simple non-photographic lodging block. Strengthen the physical dispatch-strip character of the bottom stages with tactile ticket-stock seams and clearer selected-stage depth. Keep all Russian text already present where possible, especially «Туту План Б», «Демо-данные», «Екатеринбург → Санкт-Петербург», «Надёжный», «Сбалансированный», «Бюджетный», «План Б», 87%, 84 600 ₽.
Invariants: keep the light daylight palette, deep navy/violet/coral/yellow/mint accents, accessible contrast, believable production UI, central planet occupying about half the viewport, right summary dock, and lower route-builder sequence.
Avoid: no satellite texture, no photorealism, no brand logos, no side-menu app boilerplate, no new panels, no watermark, no dark neon, no glassmorphism.
